english.title: Unlawful sexual intercourse - with girl under 16 years
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), had unlawful sexual intercourse with **(..SPECIFY NAME..), a girl under the age of 16
english.legislation: Contrary to section 6(1) of and Schedule 2 to the Sexual Offences Act 1956.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
unlawful sexual intercourse
girl
under 16 years of age

investigatoraction.description: Attracts liability for entry on sex offenders register
Consider an application for a sexual harm prevention order after conviction

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) See also offence wording: H544 - relating to USI with a girl under 13.
(ii) This offence is included in Schedule 1(1) to the Sex Offenders Act 1997, therefore a person convicted or cautioned for this offence must (subject to the exceptions and provisions contained in Schedule 1(2) and (3)) comply with the requirements of section 2 of that Act.
(iii) This offence is included in schedule 2 to the Sex Offenders Act 1997, therefore a person committing this offence outside the United Kingdom may in certain circumstances be prosecuted for that offence in England, Wales or Northern Ireland.
(iv) Repealed by s.140 of and Schedule 7 to the Sexual Offences Act 2003
(v) For historic offences of unlawful sexual intercourse with a girl under sixteen please also see R v J [2004] UKHL 42.
(vi) This offence is obsolete with no exact modern equivalent. Historical records must be reviewed case-by-case and graded/retained relating to MoPI according to the modern equivalent, taking into account individual case circumstances, victim capacity and consent, and ages of victim and offender.

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
INDICTMENT: Two years imprisonment.

Time limit for prosecutions:
Twelve months
